product.title: Day Trip to Historic St. Augustine from Orlando with Hotel Pickup

description.text: Step back in time with a visit to enchanting St Augustine — one of America’s oldest towns — on this full-day tour from Orlando. This 10-hour excursion arrives in St Augustine by mid-morning, giving you hours to spend on your favorite activities. Stroll along cobbled pathways, admire Spanish Colonial architecture, indulge in delicious seafood at a waterside restaurant, see historic landmarks, and add on an optional sightseeing cruise or trolley tour.10-hour trip to St Augustine from Orlando Explore and enjoy a relaxing lunch in colonial St Augustine, self-proclaimed oldest city in the US! Ideal for travelers basing in Orlando who want a guided Florida experience beyond the theme parks without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
